name: AFFiNE
title: AFFiNE: free Notion alternative with a whiteboard
caption:
Notion Plus costs $120/year. AFFiNE gives you docs and a whiteboard in one app, free 🎨

✅ Write docs, then flip the same page into an edgeless whiteboard
✅ Sticky notes, databases, shapes and slides on one canvas
✅ Local-first: your notes live on your own disk
✅ Unlimited local workspaces, no subscription

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The desktop app and local workspaces are free, but AFFiNE also sells optional cloud plans and an AI add-on, and Notion's $120/year is Plus at $10/month billed yearly

Comment "BOARD" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

dm_pitch: AFFiNE, the free open-source Notion alternative with a built-in whiteboard 🎨
research_notes: Verified facts (README, affine.pro, GitHub API, 2026-11-23). README tagline: 'Write, Draw and Plan All at Once'; 'A privacy-focused, local-first, open-source, and ready-to-use alternative for Notion & Miro'; 'Docs, canvas and tables are hyper-merged'. README: on the edgeless canvas you can put 'rich text, sticky notes, any embedded web pages, multi-view databases, linked pages, shapes and even slides'. README: 'Docs and whiteboard are now fully merged'. README: local-first, 'you always own your data on your disk'; real-time sync and collaboration on web and cross-platform clients. README: self-host with Docker; you can fork and build your own. README: AFFiNE AI can turn an outline into slides, summarize an article into a mindmap (AI is the paid add-on, $8.9/month billed annually per affine.pro/pricing; do not promise it free). Pricing page: 'Local FOSS + Cloud Basic' is Free with Unlimited Local Workspaces, Unlimited Doc and Edgeless editing, 10 GB cloud storage, up to 3 members per workspace; Pro $6.75/month (100 GB, 10 members); Team $10/seat/month. Platforms: GitHub releases ship macOS (arm64+x64 dmg), Windows (x64+arm64 exe), Linux (appimage, deb, flatpak); latest stable v0.27.4 (2026-08-18) had about 878k downloads; Homebrew cask 'affine' exists (v0.27.4, macOS 12+, desc 'Note editor and whiteboard'). README hero image lists macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web. Repo: about 77k stars, about 270 contributor pages (about 270 contributors), pushed today; affine.pro says 70K+ stars and 200K+ pro users. Notion Plus: $10 per member/month on notion.com/pricing (yearly toggle 'Save up to 20% with yearly'; page default is the yearly price, so $120/year). Miro cheapest paid (Starter): $8 /month per member, billed yearly (miro.com/pricing, fetched 2026-11-23). Possible script line: 'Notion plus Miro is eighteen bucks a month' (10+8, both billed yearly; only if main agent wants it, note Miro Starter is per member). License is NOASSERTION on GitHub: README says Community Edition is MIT and a future Enterprise Edition is proprietary; affine.pro says 'MIT editor, source-available backend'. Do not talk license in script.

beats.say: You're paying a hundred and twenty dollars a year for notes you could keep for free.
Notion Plus is ten bucks a month. AFFiNE costs nothing.
Write a doc, then flip the same page into a giant whiteboard.
Drop sticky notes, tables and even slides right onto the canvas.
Your notes stay on your own disk, on Mac, Windows or Linux.
It's Notion and Miro in one app, minus the bill.
